eps.d: The Kids spend all day Trying to keep animal quiet so they don't disturb their next door neighbor officer caruthers.

eps.t: Who's Afraid of the Big, Bad Dark?
eps.d: Bunsen hasn't been getting sleep lately each night beeker is waking up screaming saying that the monster attacked him in his sleep the kids realize that beeker is afraid of the ark and try to help him overcome his fears.
Foozie's tooth becomes loose and he worries about going to the dentist, and what the dentist will do to him.
During a game of hide and seek, Animal gets lost. They search the nursery up and down. Until they eventually find out that Animal was with Nanny.
All of the babies are showing their talents, but Scooter can't seem to find his. By some inspiration, he learns his talent is being computer smart.

eps.t: The Case of the Missing Chicken
eps.d: Gonzo panics when he can't find his stuff baby chicken camella.
A Misunderstanding leads the kids to belive that Nanny is going to give one of them away.

eps.t: What Do You Want to Be When You Grow Up?
eps.d: All the Muppet Babies except for Kermit know what jobs they want to have when they grow up. The babies show Kermit different jobs he can be, and he finally chooses to be a cab driver.

eps.t: Close Encounters of the Frog Kind
eps.d: Kermit and the other Muppet Babies get to meet his little nephew, Robin, the tadpole. But since he is too small, they must find him after he esapes from his bowl.
Borrowing Nanny's camcorder, The Muppet Babies make their own movies including a ""Star Wars"" parody.
Instead of waiting a week to visit the fun park, the babies make their own park right in the nursery!

eps.t: From a Galaxy Far, Far Away...
eps.d: When an alien (really an escaped Koala) ends up in the Nursery, the kids build a rocketship out of their toys so they can take it back home.
The babies accidently brake a lamp and try to compensate by preparing lunch, but they just ending up making up making a bigger mess, especially Animal.
The babies use an egg timer and a story to help Rowlf get his voice back.
When all the babies have nothing to do, Piggy takes out her activity book to play with.
Fozzie decides he doesn't want to be a comedian anymore when Piggy hurts his feelings.
Gonzo secretly and selfishly keeps cookies to himself letting the other Muppet Babies suffer from hunger until they meet an imaginary cookie-hungry bandit, One-Eyed Jake.
The babies hear about the timeline of history.

eps.t: Snow White and the Seven Muppets
eps.d: Bunson and Beaker come over, and the babies play Snow White. But Skeeter and Piggy argue over who is to play Snow White.
After their real TV set goes bad, missing their favorite show. The Muppet Babies use a pretend TV set and make their own shows.
Each Muppet Baby performs and records his or her own song for a song-writing contest and at the end, all their songs are played together as one.
The babies must convince Rolf that the zoo is not a prison for animals.
The Muppet Babies create their own cartoons.

The Muppet Babies are about to go to the art museum when Skeeter gets hurt by one of Piggy's pink skates. Before everyone could notice the skate, Piggy replaces her skate with Gonzo's in the scene of the accident so he could take the blame. Since they can't go to the art museum now, the muppets decide to bring the art museum to the nursery by creating their own works of art.

The kids are having a fun time playing boat races but when piggy cheats the fun turns into a disaster piggy claims that the rules were changed nanny tells them how rules should be agreed on and not be changed with out consulting everyone at first.

eps.t: When You Wish Upon a Muppet
eps.d: The Muppet Babies play a wishing game where they each imagine their greatest wishes coming true.

The twins decide to get some snacks from the kitchen but Piggy warns them of the consinquences for getting snacks without Nannny's permision they ignore her warning but when piggy tries to sneak the snacks back in the kitchen Nanny accuses her of stealing from the fridge and makes her clean up the mess.

eps.t: The Best Friend I Never Had
eps.d: The Muppet Babies all want to have a perfect friend but find out that they are each not what they expect.
Gonzo shows the other babies what its like to be a ""weirdo"" like him.
Scooter gets an all new Transco JoBot, and all of the Muppets want one but Nanny gives them her old toys instead.

When Nanny's TV breaks, and she complains that she can't watch the news, the Babies create their own news channel, ""MBC"". Each Muppet creates his/her own show, including Kermit and Fozzie in a newscast, and Piggy in her own soap opera.
The babies have an election for president of the nursery, and Kermit wins.

All of the babies find interesting relatives in their family tree, but Fozzie can't find his family tree. So he does not know anything about his family. Kermit and Fozzie search for some of Fozzie's relatives.
After Nanny's newspaper is ruined, the baies make their own paper of news for her.
The babies travel inside Scooter to heal him of a cold.
The babies explore the attic and find old stuff, that they never knew they had before.

After the Muppet Babies hear that Nanny is going on an ""around the world"" trip and are worried that they will not have a good sitter to look after them. They try to have her trip be in the nursery until they find out that their stand-in nursemaid will be her sister, Aunt Fanny.
The Muppet Babies befriend a talking parrot named Polly who causes them to misunderstand each other and quarrel with each other because of his loudmouthing.
Nanny tries to get the Babies to go to sleep by telling Nursery Rhymes.
After Fozzie breaks a mirror, Piggy tells him he will have bad luck for the next 7 years.

The kids are taking care of Caruther's pet mouse pewee while he is on vacation its rowlf's turn to put peewee back in his cage but he accidently leaves the door open and pewee escapes the kids go on a all night search for pewee before Nanny finds out.

When everyone is looking at Nanny's old photo album, Fozzie accidently spills cofee on an old picture of Nanny servng at a drive-through. The babies travel back in time, in a ""Back To The Future"" parody to re-take the picture of Nanny.
The babies make they're own themepark, and each babie makes there own attraction.
Nanny got an aqurarium for the muppets to look at. Skeeter thought that looking for treasure is much fun than looking at the fishes.
Gonzo thinks that he is shrinking when his basketball jersey is too big for him, but in reality He was wearing fozzie's jersey.

eps.t: Where No Muppet Has Gone Before
eps.d: Bunsen and Beaker come over, and the babies learn about different things in outer space.

eps.t: Journey to the Center of the Nursery
eps.d: After Fozzie's skate key falls down the air vent the kids go looking for it. The kids use the closet as an elevator. At each level they go down they find stranger and stranger things. The reason it's so important that Fozzie find his skate key is because he's still wearing his skates! He can't get them off! Throughout the episode Fozzie goes wheeling and sliding all over the place!

eps.t: This Little Piggy Went to Hollywood
eps.d: Piggy tells the babies about how she wil become a movie star like Shirley Temple.

Rowlf is bummed out about not getting a Valentine cookie from Nanny when the others did so the rest of the Muppet Babies try to cheer him up. Rowlf dedicates a Valentine song to his friends and Nanny gives him his cookie, saying that she forgot to put it with the other cookies.

The babies smell Nanny's cooking, and itsmells really bad. They imagine how it will taste, and what it will look like. When dinner is served, they find out that the awful smell was wallpaper paste, that Nanny was using to re-decorate the bathrom with.
The babies try different types of dancing, but Scooter doesn't know which type is bes for him.
Gonzo is accused of breaking the cookie jar and stealing cookies, so the babies hold a trial to give him a chance to defend himself. (Boy, is he in trouble...)
A bunch of peanut butter and jelly gets spilled outside the Nursery door so the kids have to stay inside until Nanny can get it cleaned up. So they make their own island.

eps.t: The Frog Who Knew Too Much
eps.d: Nanny has a big surprise for the kids Kermit is the first one to see it but the trouble is not telling the kids what it is.
Fozzie, who has never swum before, learns to swim. But it is very hard at first.
The babies try to figure out where bluberry muffins come from.
The babies learn how hard it is to babysit when they have to look after Animal and Robin, Kermit's nephew.
The babies accidently break Piggy's dollhouse, and then make one of their own for her.
The baies are getting set to go to a costume party, so eac of them decide what to wear.
The babies give Nanny a day off, and do all the work around the house so she doesn't have to.
The babies find a tea strainer of Nanny's, and do not know what it is. Each babie thinks of a different use for it.
Piggy learns that ""beauty is in the eye of the beholder"", when she makes fun of Gonzo and it hurts his feelings.

eps.t: The Pig Who Would Be Queen
eps.d: The babies bulid Nanny a ""picture box"" with a fairy tale scene, and each babie pretends to be a character.

eps.t: Is There a Muppet in the House?
eps.d: Rowlf hadn't disapeared - he'd just watched a scary movie the night before and had gone to see Nanny. The secret passage was actually an old dumbwaiter which Animal found and had been using to move between the attic, kichen and basement.
Piggy gets the chicken pox, and tells the babies the story of Sleeping Beauty, through walkie-talkie.
All the babies look foward to seeing Mrs. Mitchell's baby, which ends up being a kitten.
Scooter's tired of being a nerd, so Gonzo convinces him to reinvent himself; first as a jet fighter pilot, then as a stand-up comic, then as a rock star, and finally as a superhero.
The Babies think Kermit is moving away, so stage a ""This is Your Life"" spoof to try and convince him to stay.
The babies describe their weird dreams to each other.

The babies see a news bulletin about disapearing nannies. Gonzo says that aliens have been nannynapping them because they use green stripped socks to power their spaceships (and only nannies wear green stripped socks).
The babies make things out of old junk, while Fozzie searches for his lost Teddy.

eps.t: The Air Conditioner at the End of the Galaxy
eps.d: When the air-conditioner breaks down, Scooter and Piggy travel to find a place that is more cool.
The babies hunt for the bug in Scooter's computer in a parody of Ghostbusters.
The babies find an old time capsule in the nursery walls.

eps.t: And Now a Word from Our Muppets
eps.d: The babies make up adds for Nanny's garage sale.
The babies cant wait six to eight weeks for their playhouse to come.

When Kermit's favorite cowboy show ""The Range Rider"" gets cancelled, he contemplates trying to fill in the Range Rider's shoes (as ""The Green Ranger""). But he thinks his friends might have the wrong idea, and it takes more than fame and merchandising to be a real hero.
The Babies discover the importance of why grown-ups watch the news, and with the nursery news, they find all their favorite toys.
The Muppet Babies look at comic books and comic strips and imagine themselves as the characters in them.

Gonzo attempts to break the sound berrier while riding on a vaccum cleaner. He brings his trusty sidekick, Camilla along for a ride. However, misfortune strikes, and Camilla gets hurt, and Gonzo is unsure she'll make it. Nanny has to perform ""emergency surgery"" on Camilla, but in the end, she's alright.
Nanny read the muppets a story about Peter and the wolf.

Gonzo finds an old typewriter, and decides to write a detective novel (with himself as the hero, Philip Samuel Marlowe Spade, and Piggy as the heroine). Can his friends help him when he gets writer's block?

eps.t: The New Adventures of Kermo Polo
eps.d: The babies pretend to be famous explorer's from different periods of time.

The babies read their favorite Mother Goose book, and are transported to Goosetown, when they realize that the town just isn't the same. So, taking the matters into their own hands, they visit Mother Goose, who believes that children don't like her tales anymore, and the residents of Goosetown have all stopped taking care of themselves.
Piggy and Gonzo get so caught up in beating each other at ""Legend of Emelda: Quest for the Golden Key"", that they almost forget it's just a game, and the main goal should really be having fun.
The Muppet Babies celebrate the beauty that is poetry by talking about their favorite poems.
The babies wonder who could have been on the phone after Animal hangs up the phone.
The babies learn about different greek myths.
The babies get exited about a kitty in the nursery.
Uncle Statler and Uncle Waldorf come to visit, and the babies make inventions of their own.

eps.t: A Punch Line to the Tummy
eps.d: Fozzie's trying to be a real stand-up comedian, but Gonzo's attempts at getting ""feedback"" from his audience (the other Muppet Babies) make Fozzie think his friends don't like him anymore.
The babies parody The Jetsons, Star Trek, Bill & Ted, and Indiana Jones. Kermit pretends to be George Jetson, and tries to get Rolf to take a bath.
The babies pretend to be heroes from the old west.
The babies put on their own ""superhero opera"" while Nanny tries to watch the ""Phantom of the Opera""
Gonzo does his own conduit of tv.
The Muppet Babies version of Peter Pan with Kermit as Peter Pan, Skeeter as Wendy and Piggy as Tinkerbell.
The babies tell their own tales to each other.
The babies joke about the movies.

eps.t: In Search of the Bronzed Beetle
eps.d: The babies search for the bronze beatle that they hear about.
Statler and Waldorf join the kids in reenacting the construction of the Transcontinental Railroad.

eps.t: Get Me to the Perch on Time
eps.d: After a messenger pigeon gets hurt outside the nursery window, the Babies help her by deliverying her messages around the world.
The Nanny leave to go to the market and she leaves the alone babies.
The babies joke about remote conrols.

The Babies help Piggy find her book of ""Alice In Wonderland"" before the Book-Mobile arrives to pick-up the books. When Miss Piggy thinks she has lost it the rest of the gang helps her to make a new book with just pictures; drawn by themselves. The kids then learn that Nanny acutally had the book!
Uncle Statler and Uncle Waldorf have an aniversary.
The Babies have an adventure with the many different hats that Uncles Statler and Waldorf bring them.
When it will take five years to build the real amusement park the babies build their own - Babyland!
